question: Under which function of the Union Budget does the Government of India build roads and hospitals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allocation**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Government of India builds roads and hospitals as part of the allocation function** of the Union Budget.
 
• The Union Budget **allocates funds for infrastructure development,** including the construction of roads and hospitals. 
 
• The** Ministry of Road Transport and Highways allocates funds to state governments and union territories to develop and maintain state roads. **
 
• The Union Budget also allocates funds t**o develop healthcare infrastructure, such as public health centers and medical educati**on. 
 
• The Union Budget also allocates funds to support other infrastructure development, such as power plants and affordable housing. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Department of Economic Affairs under the Ministry of Finance has been entrusted with the responsibility of preparation and presentation of the Union Budget to Parliament.
 
• It formulates and monitors the country's economic policies and programs having a bearing on domestic and international aspects of economic management.
 
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi
 
• Ministry - Ministry of Finance
 
• Finance Minister - Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman (As of July 2022)
 
 
 
• The Union Budget is also referred to as the Annual Financial Statement in Article 112 of the Constitution of India.
 
• It is the annual budget of the Republic of India.
